name: Minimal DSGC AMPA + Mg-Block NMDA + Scalar gabaMOD
short_description: NEURON library for a minimal DSGC with co-located AMPA Exp2Syn and a custom Jahr-Stevens Mg-block NMDA POINT_PROCESS, scalar gabaMOD inhibition, and a 12-direction x 4-gNMDA x 3-mode moving-bar sweep harness.

entry_points.name: build_dsgc_from_swc
entry_points.description: Parse a calibrated SWC, collapse the soma into one Section, build one h.Section per non-soma compartment, attach a synthetic axon initial segment, and return a CellHandles dataclass.

entry_points.name: sample_dendritic_locations
entry_points.description: Sample N dendritic locations uniformly along total dendritic length using numpy.random.default_rng(seed).

entry_points.name: build_ei_pairs
entry_points.description: Construct one AMPA Exp2Syn + NMDA_MgBlock + GABA Exp2Syn triplet per Location; AMPA and NMDA share a single NetStim driven by two NetCons.

entry_points.name: schedule_ei_onsets
entry_points.description: Per-trial scheduler: set NetStim.start times from bar-leading-edge geometry; write per-trial AMPA, NMDA (gnmda_ns x 1e-3), and GABA NetCon weights.

entry_points.name: gaba_mod
entry_points.description: Scalar gabaMOD multiplier: returns 0.33 at preferred direction (theta=0) and 0.99 at null direction (theta=180).

entry_points.name: TrialMode
entry_points.description: StrEnum with members FULL, E_ONLY, GABA_ONLY for selecting which synaptic drive is active.

entry_points.name: run_one_trial
entry_points.description: Run one trial at a given (mode, angle, gnmda_ns); returns TrialResult carrying V(t), spike times, synapse onset times, and gnmda_ns.

entry_points.name: run_full_sweep
entry_points.description: End-to-end 4 gNMDA x 12 directions x 10 trials x 3 modes = 1,440-trial sweep with dry-run validation gate; writes per-mode tuning-curve / spike-time / voltage-trace CSVs and an activation-time CSV.

entry_points.name: ensure_nmda_mg_block_compiled
entry_points.description: Build code/mod/NMDA_MgBlock.mod into nrnmech.dll via run_nrnivmodl.cmd if needed, then h.nrn_load_dll the result so h.NMDA_MgBlock becomes available.

entry_points.name: compute_vector_sum_dsi
entry_points.description: Vector-sum DSI from per-angle mean firing rates: |sum r_k * exp(i theta_k)| / sum r_k.

entry_points.name: compute_preferred_direction_deg
entry_points.description: Preferred direction in degrees from the complex sum of rate-weighted unit vectors.

entry_points.name: compute_metrics_main
entry_points.description: Compute 12-variant metrics (one per gNMDA x mode) with the gNMDA = 0 cross-task regression hard-fail gate against t0054, the IPSP-conductance-ratio sanity check, and the S-0054-01 PASS/FAIL evaluation.

entry_points.name: render_figures_main
entry_points.description: Render all per-direction figures (soma V, EPSP, IPSP, PSTH, activation histogram) for each gNMDA, plus polar/Cartesian overviews and four sweep-summary plots including the Mg-block g(v) sanity curve.
